subject: alebrije
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: alebrije jaguar-eagle.
Style: Oaxacan alebrije painted wood.

spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: A painted-wood Oaxacan alebrije: a jaguar body with eagle head, folded-open wings and feathered tail, covered in dotted and swirled folk-art patterns in bright colours.
spec.layout: Quadruped jaguar standing on four stout legs facing +Z. Chunky rounded wood-carved torso (length about 1.3 m, centre y 0.85) with a long curling tail behind. A thick neck rises forward to a big eagle head with a hooked beak (upper and lower jaw separate), huge round eyes and a feather crest. Two wings spread out sideways and up from the shoulders, each with 5 wide painted feather blades in a root-to-tip rainbow palette. Everything is blocky primitives with a flat colour per part. The style is Oaxacan painted wood: the base colour is overlaid with small parts such as dot rows, spirals, stripes, diamonds and flowers in contrasting colours, with a dark outline and a light highlight on each motif. Paws rest on small round painted plinth discs at floor level only.

parts.builds: Jaguar body: a chunky loft torso in jaguarYellow with a cream belly, a rump and chest bulge, a spine ridge of small alternating magenta and turquoise diamonds, black rosette spots (ring of black dots around a magenta centre) scattered over the flanks and back, a dotted collar band between torso and neck in turquoise and white dots, and a painted saddle blanket pattern of orange zigzag triangles on the back.
parts.attaches: Neck at neckBase, legs at footF and footB mounts, wings at shoulderL and shoulderR, tail at tailRoot.

parts.builds: Four stout jaguar legs with thick thighs, shins and big round paws with cream toe discs and black claws, each in jaguarYellow with black spots and magenta, turquoise and white dotted anklet bands, and a stripe ring at the knee. Each foot stands on a thin round plinth disc in woodBrown with a violet dotted rim. Feet touch y=0.
parts.attaches: Legs start under the torso at the footFL, footFR, footBL and footBR mounts and the leg joints.

parts.builds: Eagle head and neck: a thick neck sweep in jaguarYellow with a white feather-collar of overlapping cream and turquoise cards, a big head with a cream face and a hooked beak made of separate upper jaw (beakGold) and lower jaw (orange) on the jaw joint, a black nostril, large round eyes (black outline, white, turquoise iris, black pupil, white highlight) with a magenta brow ridge above each, a crest of seven tall feather blades (red, orange, magenta, violet, skyBlue fanned back) and a dotted pattern on the cheeks. A pink tongue is inside the lower jaw.
parts.attaches: Neck starts at neckBase on the chest; head centred on headCentre; nothing sits in front of the face.

parts.builds: Two mirrored spread wings rising from the shoulders. Each has a rounded upper-arm shoulder in magenta with white dots, then 5 large extruded feather blades fanning out and up, in a root-to-tip palette (turquoise, leafGreen, skyBlue, violet, red), each blade bordered by a cream outline strip and decorated with a centre line of small dots plus a spiral or diamond motif in contrasting colours, and a row of small covert feathers in orange and yellow along the leading edge.
parts.attaches: Attach at shoulderL and shoulderR joints on the torso top edge.

parts.builds: A long curling tail swept out backward and up, built as a sweep in jaguarYellow with black bands ring pattern, ending in a fan of 5 eagle tail feathers (red, orange, magenta, violet, turquoise with cream tips and dotted centres) plus a small spiral curl accent in turquoise and a row of white dots along its top. Includes a small cluster of back-hip decorative flowers (pink petals, yellow centres, green leaves) at the tail root.
parts.attaches: Starts at tailRoot on the hips; chain tail1 to tail3.
